row.evidence: Argo CD's RBAC docs say it "does not have its own user management system and has only one built-in user, admin"; SSO users come from an OIDC provider (or Dex for SAML/LDAP) and are mapped to roles by groups, so there is nothing to provision over SCIM.
row.notes: New row. Argo CD is a free, open-source (Argo project) GitOps tool that customers self-host; there is no paid plan, so price fields are null and the project page stands in for a pricing page. Argo CD keeps no user directory: SSO users authenticate through an existing OIDC provider (Okta, OneLogin, Auth0, Microsoft, Keycloak, Google) or the bundled Dex (for SAML/LDAP) and get access through group-to-role RBAC mappings, so IdP group membership controls access on each sign-in. Local accounts are defined in the argocd-cm ConfigMap and deleted by removing the entry. The REST API (Swagger at /swagger-ui) manages applications, projects and accounts' tokens, not SSO users. No SCIM endpoint exists. Commercial hosted Argo CD (Akuity, Red Hat OpenShift GitOps) is sold by other vendors and not covered here. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: Argo CD has no user store to provision: SSO identities and groups come from the OIDC token on each login. The docs sitemap (argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/sitemap.xml) has no SCIM page. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: Argo CD's REST/gRPC API (Swagger at /swagger-ui on each install) covers applications, projects, sessions and account tokens; local users are defined in the argocd-cm ConfigMap rather than created through an API, and SSO users are not stored.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'argocd' returned no integrations; Argo CD's Okta guide uses a custom SAML (via Dex) or OIDC app with group attribute statements for RBAC.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com argo-cd-tutorial and argocd-tutorial return 404; Argo CD documents Microsoft as a custom OIDC/SAML app.

google.notes: Argo CD documents Google as an OIDC/SAML provider; no Marketplace app.

onelogin.notes: Argo CD documents OneLogin as an OIDC provider; connector page not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Group-based access: IdP group claims in the OIDC/SAML token map to Argo CD RBAC roles on each login (no user records stored)
fallbacks.notes: jit is null because Argo CD never creates user records; SSO users are authorized from token claims at sign-in. csv_import false: local users are only defined in the argocd-cm ConfigMap.
